scientific_limitations_integrity: The sharp rational endpoint constant is proved only for the bi-infinite strictly alternating positive two-length grid; finite periodic projectors satisfy the same sharp uniform envelope over repeat count. The result does not establish an exact norm at each fixed period, general-knot optimality, or higher-order-spline bounds. Priority may depend on inaccessible 2012 specialist literature. Computational checks support rather than replace the analytical proof; independent audit has not occurred.
title: Exact endpoint stability for alternating-knot linear spline projections
